label: meta.keyspace parameter
type: the additional argument an Advanced Keyspace Accessor call must supply when its binding uses a wildcard (`*`) scope or collection, naming the specific bucket/scope/collection the operation actually targets.
recurrence_note: 4 files, shared-source discounted to 2 - exactly at the promotion bar; the family exception is not invoked, this clears the mechanical rule as-is.
evidence: If the binding used by the Advanced Keyspace Accessor also contains a wildcard `*` for its scope or collection, you must use the additional `meta.keyspace` parameter.

meta.keyspace | Object | The keyspace of the document to be used for the operation. Must be in the JavaScript format "keyspace": { "bucket_name": string, "scope_name": string, "collection_name": string }.
relates_to_competency_question: When a binding is wildcarded, how does an Advanced Accessor call know which specific collection to touch?
